                    ### Question
                    Which of the following changes is the most potent stimulus for glucagon secretion?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Gastric filling
opb. Hyperglycemia
opc. Hypernatremia
opd. Pass from chyme to duodenum.
ope. Hypoglycemia

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Hypoglycemia is the most potent stimulus for glucagon secretion. This is because hypoglycemia stimulates alpha cells in the pancreas, triggering glucagon secretion. Hyperglycemia inhibits glucagon secretion. Evidence supports the relationship between hyperglycemia and glucagon secretion.
